findings.ref: specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/verification/T-003.red.log vs specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/verification/qg/T-003/unit-acceptance-green.log; T-003.contract.json checks[unit-tests].red_evidence and checks[acceptance-tests].red_evidence; tasks.md T-003 'Required Workflow: tdd' and Done-When 'TDD evidence'
findings.note: The RED evidence is stale and covers a superseded, smaller suite. T-003.red.log records exactly 14 assertions (static-a..j, functional-a/b/c, and one 'defense-in-depth: ship-time recheck skill is untouched' grep) with 'Results: 1 passed, 13 failed'; the GREEN log for the same suite records 31. Roughly 18 currently-shipped assertions have no captured RED at all: static-g2, static-p, static-q, static-k..o, fixture-catalog, functional-registry-shape, functional-baseline, defense-in-depth-a/b/c and TEST-021a/b/c; static-g's own predicate also changed (red log's needle was 'regardless of whether the', the current one is the '--lite never overrides this decision' clause). The contract comment concedes the red log is 'reused rather than re-captured'. For a Risk: high / tdd task whose Done-When demands RED then GREEN, the discriminating power of most of the suite rests only on mutation runs narrated in prose in reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-003.md, with no captured log anywhere in the bundle.

findings.ref: tests/fixtures/epic-194-lite-spec/scenarios.json (registry.capabilities[0] vs defense_in_depth.fragment and defense_in_depth._note); the matching inline comments above TEST-019-defense-in-depth-b in both twins; tasks.md T-003 Done-When 'Defense-in-depth confirmed'; design.md Test Strategy item 6
findings.note: The defense-in-depth fixture's stated premise is contradicted by the fixture file that carries it. scenarios.json's registry declares capability id 'payment-processing-svc' on component 'payment-service' with lite_policy.eligible=false and upgrade_reasons=['financial_settlement'] - the very entry the ineligible-Block path matches - while defense_in_depth.fragment hand-authors the SAME id with eligible: true. Both twins' comments then state that this capability is 'excluded from the fragment entirely', which is false of the fragment they actually write (the entry is present, merely eligible:true). Applying the documented assembly rule to this catalog's own project_context + registry would yield an ineligible entry and Block at intake, so TEST-019-defense-in-depth-b does not demonstrate 'a component the intake-time evaluation did not itself flag' (Done-When item 4, OQ-002 resolution); it demonstrates only that check-risk-upgrade ignores an eligible:true fragment entry. The ship-side half (defense-in-depth-c) is a plain SECRET-keyword hit on sources.defense_in_depth_ship, the same keyword row sources.keyword_match already exercises.

findings.ref: specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/verification/T-003.contract.json checks[regression].passes=false and checks[placeholder-scan].passes=false (both required:true), and its comment 'No quality-gate report exists for this feature -- verification/qg/ holds logs only'; qg/shared/regression.log ('passes stays FALSE ... Full-repository regression does not pass on this branch'); qg/shared/placeholder-scan.log ('Placeholder scan FAILED (5 finding(s)) ... exit: 1' against CHANGELOG.md); tasks.md T-003 Done-When 'TDD evidence' final clause
findings.note: Two required checks of the Default-FAIL verification contract are recorded false, so the contract cannot certify a pass. regression is false on real, unwaived, non-designed-red suites (workflow-state, check-component-coverage, repository-release-validation). placeholder-scan is false on CHANGELOG.md, which T-003 declares as one of its own Outputs; check-placeholders.sh's own message admits only two dispositions (implement properly, or explicit human acceptance recorded in the quality-gate report) and the contract itself states no quality-gate report exists for this feature, so no human acceptance is on record. The Done-When clause 'An independent quality-gate verdict records PASS, with a named second reviewer distinct from the implementing agent' is therefore unmet, and no such verdict appears anywhere in the bundle.

findings.ref: tasks.md T-003 Done-When 'HUMAN APPLY STEP'; reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-003.md ('HUMAN APPLY STEP: NOT satisfied, correctly still pending'); acceptance-tests.md AC-010 ('Status resolves through the AC-031 runner, not a bare human cp'), AC-021, AC-031
findings.note: An unmet Done-When item, disclosed rather than hidden: no human has run T-001's apply-protected-files.ps1 against T-003's staged lite-spec/SKILL.md, so the payload has never been applied, its post-copy re-verification has never reported success, and AC-010/AC-031 do not resolve. The live plugins/sdd-lite/skills/lite-spec/SKILL.md is unchanged, and every assertion in the suite reads the staged candidate only. The task's own text scopes this as Done-gating rather than Implementation-Complete-gating and the contract excludes it as not machine-checkable, but it remains an open Done-When item that nothing in this bundle closes.

findings.ref: CHANGELOG.md (bundle section headed 'CURRENT worktree content; implementation report's declared hash for this path is STALE'): '## Unreleased' contains only '### Fixed'/'### Changed'/'### Fixed' and no #194 bullet, while 'Epic 194 T-003 lite-spec's Risk-Upgrade Gate, Capability-derived Block, staged (#194)' sits under '## v1.16.0 (2026-08-22)' '### Added'; reports/.../T-003.md Outputs row for CHANGELOG.md
findings.note: tasks.md T-003 Done-When requires that 'CHANGELOG.md gains a NEW ## Unreleased entry citing #194'. Read literally against the current tree that is no longer true - the v1.16.0 release cut moved the entry out of Unreleased. The substance (a T-003-specific entry citing #194) does exist and is verifiable, so this is lifecycle drift rather than a missing deliverable, but the implementation report's Outputs table still declares a CHANGELOG.md SHA-256 (75eb30d7...) that the bundle header itself flags as stale, so the report's own record of this item no longer matches the file.

findings.ref: tasks.md T-003 Done-When 'Suite/CI registration + governance'; reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-003.md Outputs table (8 rows, containing neither tests/run-all.sh/.ps1 nor specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/human-copy/.github/workflows/test.yml)
findings.note: Two of this item's three clauses are unverifiable from the bundle. The report supports 'suite registered third in both run-all arrays' and 'the staged .github/workflows/test.yml candidate carries T-003's two steps' only by asserting they were 'grep-confirmed, unchanged' from T-001's resume; neither file is declared in the Outputs table, so neither reaches this review. That is exactly the implementer self-report a blind panel cannot credit - the same gap class the report says it closed for the staged SKILL.md row.

findings.ref: specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/verification/T-003.contract.json, spec_revision field '2740928c9e9c45cd56644a0e22e4fb5fc3c270932eba9c8fecf4a8450780d437' and the disclosure paragraph in its comment naming '466465e04248cb912635ed83435ff0c17e9805648e0caead7132ad6276a34d23'
findings.note: The contract's spec_revision was computed 2026-08-19, before the 2026-08-21 AC-010 five-target amendment (9997091c) and the propagation commits after it, so the contract binds its evidence to a specification revision that is not the one under review. The correct current value is recorded in the comment but deliberately not written into the field, deferring re-issue to the next quality-gate run. Disclosed and reasoned, but until re-issued the evidence set is not hash-bound to the spec the Done-When items cite.

findings.ref: qg/T-003/unit-acceptance-green.log header (HEAD 4905c131..., 2026-08-25T11:55:46Z) vs qg/shared/task-state-check.log (HEAD 7e282bb1..., 2026-08-25T10:41:55Z) vs qg/shared/placeholder-scan.log and qg/shared/traceability-check.log (both 2026-08-19T04:52) vs qg/shared/regression.log third section (HEAD 7635250c...); T-003.contract.json comment '14/14 both runtimes -- 10 static + 3 functional + 1 defense-in-depth'
findings.note: The contract presents itself as a quality-gate pass 'over the current tree', but its named evidence was captured at four different HEADs across six days, and its own description of T-003's suite (14/14, 10 static + 3 functional + 1 defense-in-depth) describes a suite shape the evidence it points at no longer has (31 assertions, including TEST-021a/b/c and the executing defense-in-depth pair). regression.log likewise carries three superseded per-suite tallies for this same suite (14, then 27, then 27) across its appended sections. Nothing is concealed, but a reader cannot take the contract's prose as a description of the logs it cites without reconciling them by hand.
